title: Consumer Confidence Impact and Buying Behavior
content: Rules for adjusting inventory and marketing based on consumer confidence indices. When consumer confidence is high, customers are willing to spend more. Action: Push premium products, up-sell, and create bundle offers. Increase marketing spend for luxury or non-essential items. When consumer confidence is low, customers become price-sensitive. Action: Focus on essentials, value packs, and discounts. Reduce exposure of luxury items and focus on staple goods.

title: Social Media Sentiment and Viral Trends
content: Adjusting store focus based on viral trends and local sentiment. When social media sentiment around a local event or product is positive, capitalize on the optimism by highlighting new arrivals and trending brands. Use localized marketing campaigns to align with the positive sentiment.

title: Local Events and School Reopening Impact
content: Reopening of schools or major local sports tournaments dramatically shifts purchasing patterns. During School Reopening weeks, Stationery demand increases by 50%, Snacks by 30%, and Beverages by 20%. Action: Stock up heavily on back-to-school items, quick lunchbox snacks, and hygiene products.
